title: Self-Evaluation Improves Selective Generation in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multi-choice answer selection by comparing a vanilla setting (where candidate answers are ordered by default) against a de-biased setting (where answer scores are averaged across all possible permutations) to mitigate the model's preference for specific option positions.

Comparing standard sequence-level likelihood scores with length-normalized sequence likelihood scores to account for and correct the model's tendency to underestimate the sequence likelihood of longer sentences.
